controls.title: Minimalna duljina lozinke
controls.description: Određuje najmanji broj znakova koji lozinka mora imati. Dužu lozinku puno je teže pogoditi ili probiti.
controls.impact: Kod sljedeće promjene lozinke korisnici moraju odabrati dužu lozinku; postojeće lozinke i PIN i dalje rade.

benchmarks.recommendation: 14 ili više znakova
14 ili više znakova

controls.notes: secedit [System Access] applies to LOCAL (SAM) accounts. Domain accounts take password policy only from a GPO linked at the domain root (or Fine-Grained Password Policies); an OU-linked GPO only changes local accounts of the member computers. In domain mode these keys must go into the GPO's GptTmpl.inf - Set-GPRegistryValue cannot write them. len-16 needs RelaxMinimumPasswordLengthLimits=1 in place BEFORE secedit imports MinimumPasswordLength>14 (write the SAM value / refresh policy first), otherwise the import is rejected. len-16 is deliberately not used by any level: Windows LAPS-generated local admin passwords must satisfy local policy, and LAPS PasswordLength below 16 (CIS asks 15+) would make rotation fail. Microsoft/Entra accounts and Windows Hello PINs are not affected. NIST SP 800-63B-4 suggests 15+ for single-factor passwords.

controls.title: Složene lozinke
controls.description: Lozinka mora sadržavati znakove iz barem tri skupine (velika slova, mala slova, brojke, posebni znakovi) i ne smije sadržavati korisničko ime. Takve lozinke teže je pogoditi.
controls.impact: Kod sljedeće promjene lozinke jednostavne lozinke poput 'ljeto2026' više se ne prihvaćaju.

benchmarks.recommendation: Uključeno
Uključeno

controls.notes: Local default on stand-alone Windows 11 is Disabled. Enforced only at the next password change. NIST SP 800-63B discourages composition rules, but both CIS and MSB still require this, so it is on at every level.

controls.title: Bez ponavljanja starih lozinki
controls.description: Windows pamti zadnje 24 lozinke i ne dopušta njihovo ponovno korištenje. Stara, možda otkrivena lozinka tako se ne vraća u upotrebu.
controls.impact: Pri promjeni lozinke korisnik ne može ponovno upotrijebiti neku od prethodnih lozinki.

benchmarks.recommendation: Pamti se 24 ili više lozinki
Pamti se 24 lozinke

controls.notes: Only meaningful together with accounts.password-min-age (otherwise a user can change the password 24 times in a row and return to the old one).

controls.title: Najduže trajanje lozinke
controls.description: Nakon zadanog broja dana Windows traži novu lozinku. Današnje preporuke savjetuju rijetke promjene, a lozinku treba odmah promijeniti ako postoji sumnja da je otkrivena.
controls.impact: Korisnici jednom godišnje (ili svakih 90 dana) moraju smisliti novu lozinku.

benchmarks.recommendation: 365 dana ili manje, ali ne 0 (lozinka mora jednom isteći)

controls.notes: MSB deliberately does NOT configure password expiration since the Windows 10 1903 baseline (Microsoft: periodic expiration is 'an ancient and obsolete mitigation of very low value'); NIST SP 800-63B also rejects forced periodic changes. days-90 is offered only for regulatory needs (e.g. PCI DSS when the password is the only factor) and is not used by any level. In secedit -1 means 'never expires' and 0 is also 'never' in the UI; atMost (0 < actual <= ours) correctly reads both as non-compliant. Keep MinimumPasswordAge < MaximumPasswordAge.

controls.title: Najkraće trajanje lozinke
controls.description: Nova lozinka mora vrijediti barem jedan dan prije sljedeće promjene. Tako korisnik ne može u nekoliko brzih promjena vratiti staru lozinku.
controls.impact: Korisnik ne može promijeniti lozinku dvaput u istom danu; administrator je po potrebi može resetirati.

benchmarks.recommendation: 1 dan ili više

controls.notes: Not part of MSB. Works together with password history.

controls.title: Bez čitljivo spremljenih lozinki
controls.description: Windows nikada ne sprema lozinke na način iz kojega se mogu vratiti u izvorni tekst. Takvo spremanje gotovo je isto kao lozinka zapisana na papiriću.
controls.impact: Korisnici ništa ne primjećuju.

benchmarks.recommendation: Isključeno spremanje lozinki uz povratnu enkripciju
Isključeno spremanje lozinki uz povratnu enkripciju

controls.notes: Windows default is already 0; setting it explicitly guards against legacy CHAP/IIS digest configurations re-enabling it.

controls.title: Lozinke duže od 14 znakova
controls.description: Uklanja staro ograničenje prema kojem pravilo minimalne duljine lozinke ne može tražiti više od 14 znakova. Bez ove postavke ne može se zadati strože pravilo duljine.
controls.impact: Korisnici ništa ne primjećuju.

benchmarks.recommendation: Uključeno

controls.notes: Security Options value (Windows 10 2004+/Server 2022+). Has no effect by itself; it only allows MinimumPasswordLength > 14 (see accounts.password-length len-16). Not part of MSB. CIS 1.1.6 number inferred from v5.0.1 1.1.5/1.1.7 being confirmed and v4.0.0 order.

controls.title: Zaključavanje nakon pogrešnih lozinki
controls.description: Nakon nekoliko pogrešno upisanih lozinki račun se privremeno zaključava. To zaustavlja napadače koji pokušavaju pogoditi lozinku.
controls.impact: Tko više puta pogrešno upiše lozinku, mora pričekati 10 do 15 minuta ili zamoliti administratora da otključa račun.

benchmarks.recommendation: Najviše 5 pogrešnih pokušaja (ne 0); zaključavanje i poništavanje brojača nakon 15 ili više minuta
10 pokušaja, zaključavanje 10 minuta, brojač se poništava nakon 10 minuta

controls.notes: matchMode cannot express mixed semantics: when reading state, LockoutBadCount should be judged atMost (0 < actual <= ours) and LockoutDuration/ResetLockoutCount atLeast; 'exact' is used to stay safe (consider a per-key override in the engine). MSB counts cis-5 as satisfying because the MSB checks used by HardeningKitty/AuditTAP are threshold <= 10 and durations >= 10; a literal diff (Policy Analyzer) will still show a difference. secedit rules: ResetLockoutCount must be <= LockoutDuration and durations are ignored when LockoutBadCount = 0, so write LockoutBadCount first. Windows 11 22H2+ already ships 10/10/10 as the local default. Both standards also require 'Allow Administrator account lockout' = Enabled (secedit AllowAdministratorLockout = 1, CIS 1.2.3): default on Win11 22H2+, but the key is not in the allowed security key list - consider adding it. Domain accounts follow the domain-root policy only. Windows Hello PIN has its own TPM anti-hammering.

controls.title: Isključen račun Gost
controls.description: Ugrađeni račun Gost omogućuje ulazak bez lozinke. Kad je isključen, nitko se ne može anonimno prijaviti na računalo.
controls.impact: Korisnici ništa ne primjećuju jer je račun Gost u Windowsima 11 obično već isključen.

benchmarks.recommendation: Račun Gost isključen

controls.notes: Not in MSB (disabled by default). The CIS 'rename guest/administrator account' items are omitted because they need free-text input.

controls.title: Prazne lozinke samo lokalno
controls.description: Lokalni računi bez lozinke mogu se koristiti samo za prijavu za samim računalom, a ne preko mreže ili udaljene radne površine.
controls.impact: Korisnici ništa ne primjećuju.

benchmarks.recommendation: Uključeno
Uključeno

controls.notes: Windows default is already 1; explicit value protects against tools that relax it.

controls.title: Automatsko zaključavanje zaslona
controls.description: Ako nitko ne koristi računalo zadano vrijeme, Windows zaključava zaslon. Tako nitko drugi ne može raditi na računalu dok je korisnik odsutan.
controls.impact: Nakon razdoblja neaktivnosti korisnik ponovno upisuje lozinku ili PIN.

benchmarks.recommendation: 900 sekundi (15 min) ili manje, ali ne 0
900 sekundi (15 min)

controls.notes: Security option 'Interactive logon: Machine inactivity limit'. Microsoft Learn states a restart is required. 0 or empty disables it; maximum 599940. CIS item was 2.3.7.4 in v4.0.0 and is 2.3.7.3 in v5.0.1 (the BitLocker 'Machine account lockout threshold' item no longer sits before it). MSB literally specifies 900; stricter values are counted as satisfying, though literal-diff tools will flag 600/300.

controls.title: Skrivanje zadnjeg korisnika
controls.description: Zaslon za prijavu ne prikazuje ime osobe koja se zadnja prijavila. Napadač tako ne dobiva unaprijed pola podataka potrebnih za prijavu.
controls.impact: Korisnici pri svakoj prijavi moraju upisati i korisničko ime, a ne samo lozinku ili PIN.

benchmarks.recommendation: Uključeno (ne prikazuj zadnjeg prijavljenog korisnika)

controls.notes: CIS L1 item intentionally kept out of level 2: it removes the user tile, so staff must type their account name (e.g. AzureAD\name or e-mail) before PIN/password on every sign-in - heavy friction for non-technical users. Not in MSB. Applies at the next sign-in screen, no restart.

controls.title: Prijava uz Ctrl+Alt+Del
controls.description: Prije prijave treba pritisnuti Ctrl+Alt+Del. Tu kombinaciju tipki prima samo Windows, pa lažni zaslon za prijavu ne može ukrasti lozinku.
controls.impact: Prije upisa lozinke ili PIN-a korisnici pritišću Ctrl+Alt+Del.

benchmarks.recommendation: 'Ne traži CTRL+ALT+DEL' isključeno, tj. tipke su obavezne

controls.notes: Moved from Level 1 (v4.0.0) to Level 2 in CIS v5.x (listed in the v5.0.1 benchmark as L2 and present in Tenable's v5.1.0 L2-only audit). Not in MSB. On keyboard-less tablets the secure attention sequence is Win+Power. Microsoft notes reverting requires removing the DisableCAD value, not just 'Not defined'.

controls.title: Automatska ažuriranja Windowsa
controls.description: Windows sam preuzima i instalira sigurnosne zakrpe čim izađu, bez odgode. Tako računalo uvijek ima najnoviju zaštitu.
controls.impact: Ako računalo ostane uključeno preko noći, može se samo ponovno pokrenuti oko 3 sata ujutro.

benchmarks.recommendation: Automatska ažuriranja uključena (bilo koja opcija osim isključivanja); Dan zakazane instalacije: svaki dan; Staro pravilo 'Bez automatskog restarta dok je korisnik prijavljen' isključeno; Sigurnosne (kvalitativne) zakrpe bez odgode: 0 dana

controls.notes: The option values match what the GP editor writes when 'Configure Automatic Updates' is enabled with option 4 (auto download + scheduled install, every day 03:00, every week) or option 3 (auto download, notify to install). ScheduledInstallDay/Time are written for both options because the ADMX writes these elements whatever option is chosen, and the CIS audit reads only the registry value. The quality-update deferral is merged in here (DeferQualityUpdates=1, DeferQualityUpdatesPeriodInDays=0 = CIS 'Select when Quality Updates are received' Enabled: 0 days) so the user sees one 'patch immediately' switch. It is a WUfB policy, so WSUS-managed devices ignore it. NoAutoRebootWithLoggedOnUsers=0 is the CIS L1 'Disabled' state of a legacy policy. Microsoft says it was never built as a CSP and does not apply to Windows 11, so writing 0 only passes the CIS audit and changes nothing. Restarts are controlled by active hours and deadlines (see updates.active-hours and updates.deadlines), which Microsoft recommends over legacy restart policies. MSB (25H2/26H2) has no Windows Update settings. CIS numbers are for v4.0.0; in v5.0.x this section moved to 18.10.94 (Tenable lists 18.10.94.2.2 'Scheduled install day' for v5.0.0). AUOptions 5 and 7 (Server only) are deliberately not offered.

controls.title: Rok za instalaciju i restart
controls.description: Određuje najviše koliko dana smije proći od izlaska zakrpe do njezine instalacije i ponovnog pokretanja. Korisnik može odgađati restart, ali samo do isteka roka.
controls.impact: Kad rok istekne, računalo se ponovno pokreće uz upozorenje, pa i tijekom radnog vremena.
controls.notes: Neither CIS Windows 11 Enterprise nor MSB sets deadlines. Microsoft recommends them to make sure patches actually get installed (Windows Update client policies). Option titles give the quality-update deadline. The feature-update deadline is 14/7/7 days, and the grace period (days after install before a forced restart) is 3/2/1 for both. Update CSP ranges: deadlines 0-30, grace 0-7. These names are documented: ConfigureDeadlineForQualityUpdates, ConfigureDeadlineForFeatureUpdates, ConfigureDeadlineGracePeriod, ConfigureDeadlineGracePeriodForFeatureUpdates, and the legacy enable flag SetComplianceDeadline. Since Windows 11 22H2 the ADMX splits the policy in two: ComplianceDeadline (quality updates) and ComplianceDeadlineForFU (feature updates). A third-party ADMX viewer gives their enable flags as SetComplianceDeadlineForQU and SetComplianceDeadlineForFU. I found no Microsoft text confirming these two names. They are written as a precaution so that both old and new ADMX/clients see the policy as enabled. Check WindowsUpdate.admx on a 25H2/26H2 machine and drop them if they are not there. The 'don't auto-restart until end of grace period' flags (ConfigureDeadlineNoAutoReboot / ...ForQualityUpdates / ...ForFeatureUpdates) are left out on purpose: their names differ between ADMX generations, and Microsoft's update-policies doc says to leave them off so restarts are scheduled outside active hours. Once deadline plus grace has passed, the restart ignores active hours. matchMode atMost: a shorter deadline already set on the PC counts as compliant.

controls.title: Bez restarta u radno vrijeme
controls.description: Windows neće sam ponovno pokretati računalo između 7 i 19 sati. Ažuriranja se dovršavaju izvan tog vremena.
controls.impact: Korisnici ništa ne primjećuju; restart se događa navečer ili noću, osim kad istekne rok za ažuriranje.
controls.notes: GP 'Turn off auto-restart for updates during active hours' (SetActiveHours=1; ActiveHoursStart/End as hours 0-23). Windows 10 1703 and later allow up to 18 active hours; 7-19 is 12. Not in CIS or MSB. Added as the usability partner of updates.deadlines and updates.automatic, because Microsoft recommends deadlines + active hours instead of legacy restart policies. Once deadline plus grace period has passed, Windows restarts regardless of active hours.

controls.title: Odgoda velikih nadogradnji
controls.description: Nova godišnja verzija Windowsa stiže tek 180 dana nakon izlaska. Do tada Microsoft ispravi većinu početnih grešaka, a sigurnosne zakrpe i dalje stižu odmah.
controls.impact: Nove mogućnosti Windowsa stižu otprilike pola godine kasnije.

benchmarks.recommendation: Velike nadogradnje odgođene 180 ili više dana

controls.notes: GP 'Select when Preview Builds and Feature Updates are received' writes DeferFeatureUpdates=1, BranchReadinessLevel and DeferFeatureUpdatesPeriodInDays (max 365). BranchReadinessLevel=16 is what the GP editor writes for the General Availability (formerly Semi-Annual) channel; since 1903 the two semi-annual values were merged into 16. The HardeningKitty CIS lists use BranchReadinessLevel=2 (Insider Dev/Fast), which looks like an error in the list; CIS only requires 'Enabled: 180 or more days'. With atLeast, 365 days or BranchReadinessLevel 32 also pass. Deferrals are ignored when a Target Release Version policy is set, and on WSUS-managed devices. The quality-update deferral (0 days, CIS 18.10.93.4.3) is in updates.automatic. Not in MSB.

controls.title: Samo provjerena ažuriranja
controls.description: Računalo ne prima probne (Insider) verzije Windowsa ni neobavezna probna ažuriranja. Nove mogućnosti koje su po zadanom isključene ostaju isključene.
controls.impact: Korisnici ništa ne primjećuju.

benchmarks.recommendation: Upravljanje probnim verzijama (Manage preview builds): Disabled; Neobavezna ažuriranja (Enable optional updates): Disabled; Novosti iz servisiranja koje su po zadanom isključene: Disabled

controls.notes: Three CIS L1 items merged into one switch. (1) Manage preview builds: CIS Windows 11 Enterprise has recommended 'Disabled' (ManagePreviewBuilds=0) since v2.0.0 (Tenable changelog rev 1.3). Syxsense shows the same 'Disabled' wording under the v5 number 18.10.94.4.1. HardeningKitty's v4 list instead checks ManagePreviewBuilds=1 + ManagePreviewBuildsPolicyValue=0 ('Enabled: Disable preview builds', the older Windows 10 wording). Both states block Insider builds, but a PC set up that way will read as not matching. (2) Enable optional updates = Disabled: the ADMX enable flag is SetAllowOptionalContent (0 = disabled). AllowOptionalContent=0 (CSP 'don't receive optional updates') is also written because the HardeningKitty CIS check reads that value. (3) Enable features introduced via servicing that are off by default = Disabled: AllowTemporaryEnterpriseFeatureControl=0, which is the default behaviour. In CIS v5.0.1, item (3) is numbered 18.10.94.2.3. Not in MSB.

controls.title: Zabrani pauziranje ažuriranja
controls.description: Korisnici ne mogu u postavkama pauzirati ažuriranja na nekoliko tjedana. Tako zakrpe ne kasne zbog zaboravljene pauze.
controls.impact: Gumb za pauziranje ažuriranja u postavkama bit će nedostupan.

benchmarks.recommendation: Ukloniti korisnicima mogućnost pauziranja ažuriranja

controls.notes: GP 'Remove access to "Pause updates" feature' (SetDisablePauseUXAccess=1). Not in MSB. In CIS v5.0.1, number 18.10.94.2.3 belongs to 'Enable features introduced via servicing...', so this item was renumbered or removed in v5 (not checked). Level 1 leaves it unset so small offices are not surprised.

controls.title: USB memorije i memorijske kartice
controls.description: Određuje što zaposlenici smiju raditi s USB memorijama i memorijskim karticama. Zabrana pokretanja programa sprječava da se virus pokrene izravno s USB-a.
controls.impact: Ovisno o izboru: programi se ne pokreću s USB-a, na USB se ne može spremati ili se USB, CD i mobitel kao disk uopće ne otvaraju; tipkovnice, miševi i pisači rade normalno.
controls.notes: RemovableStorage.admx (System > Removable Storage Access): RemovableDisks_DenyExecute_Access_2 (Machine only, Win7+), RemovableDisks_DenyWrite_Access_2 and RemovableDisks_DenyRead_Access_2 -> HKLM\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\RemovableStorageDevices\{53f5630d-b6bf-11d0-94f2-00a0c91efb8b} Deny_Execute/Deny_Write/Deny_Read = DWORD 1. RemovableStorageClasses_DenyAll_Access_2 -> ...\RemovableStorageDevices Deny_All = DWORD 1. Deny_All overrides every class policy and also blocks CD/DVD, floppy, tape and WPD devices such as phones/cameras over MTP. Deny_Read/Deny_Write/Deny_All also exist as User-scope (HKCU) policies; this control manages only the Machine scope. Option 'Dozvoljeno' also deletes Deny_Read, so a value set by another tool is cleared. Restart: the ADML help of AccessRights_RebootTime says 'If no reboot is forced, the access right does not take effect until the operating system is restarted', hence requiresRestart=true. Newly inserted media often pick up the change after a policy refresh, but an already mounted volume keeps its access until it is plugged in again. We deliberately do NOT set RebootTimeinSeconds_state/RebootTimeinSeconds, because that forces a reboot. Neither CIS Windows 11 (L1/L2) nor the Microsoft Security Baseline has Removable Storage Access recommendations. Both only use Device Installation restrictions against DMA (SBP-2/Thunderbolt classes; CIS BitLocker profile + MSB BitLocker GPO), which belong to the BitLocker/system group. Deny_Execute stops executables from starting on the medium; it is not full application control. Enterprise alternative: Defender for Endpoint Device Control. Not verified for USB hard disks/SSDs that report as fixed media: test before relying on it.

controls.title: Bez automatskog pokretanja
controls.description: Kad se umetne USB ili CD ili spoji mobitel, Windows ništa ne pokreće sam niti nudi pokretanje. Tako su se nekad širili virusi s USB-a.
controls.impact: Pri umetanju USB-a ne pojavljuje se prozor s ponudom radnji; datoteke se otvaraju ručno u File Exploreru.

benchmarks.recommendation: AutoPlay isključen za sve pogone; AutoRun: ne izvršavati nikakve autorun naredbe; Bez AutoPlaya za uređaje koji nisu diskovi (mobiteli, kamere)
Sve tri AutoPlay/AutoRun postavke isključene, kao u CIS-u

controls.notes: AutoPlay.admx: policy 'Autorun' (Turn off Autoplay) is an enum NoDriveTypeAutoRun: 181 = CD-ROM and removable, 255 = All drives. Policy 'NoAutorun' (Set the default behavior for AutoRun) is an enum: 1 = Do not execute any autorun commands, 2 = Automatically execute. Both live under Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer and are class Both (also HKCU); CIS/MSB check the HKLM values, which is what we write. NoAutoplayfornonVolume (Disallow Autoplay for non-volume devices, MTP phones/cameras) is under Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer. Item numbers are CIS v4.0.0. The same three items are L1 in v5.0.1 (Fleet v5.0.1 policy set; 18.10.8.3 confirmed in the v5.0.1 table of contents) and are 18.10.7.1-3 in v3.0.0. requiresRestart=false: Explorer reads the policy when media arrives. A signed-in session may rarely need a sign-out; not checked against a primary source.

controls.title: Upis samo na šifrirane USB diskove
controls.description: Na USB disk se može spremati samo ako je zaštićen BitLockerom. Ako se disk izgubi ili ukrade, podaci na njemu ostaju nečitljivi.
controls.impact: Nešifrirani USB diskovi otvaraju se samo za čitanje, a Windows nudi da ih korisnik šifrira; takav disk se ne može čitati na Macu, televizoru ili pisaču.

benchmarks.recommendation: Uključeno, bez zabrane upisa na diskove šifrirane u drugoj organizaciji

controls.notes: VolumeEncryption.admx policy RDVDenyWriteAccess_Name (BitLocker Drive Encryption > Removable Data Drives > Deny write access to removable drives not protected by BitLocker) writes RDVDenyWriteAccess under System\CurrentControlSet\Policies\Microsoft\FVE (NOT Software\Policies). The policy also has a REQUIRED boolean element RDVCrossOrg, written as RDVDenyCrossOrg under Software\Policies\Microsoft\FVE. Value 0 means 'Do not allow write access to devices configured in another organization' is unchecked. MSB 25H2/26H2 (BitLocker GPO): RDVDenyWriteAccess=1, RDVDenyCrossOrg=0. CIS has it only in the BitLocker (BL) profile, not in L1/L2: v4.0.0 18.10.10.3.14 (Enabled) and 18.10.10.3.15 (cross-org False). Therefore there is no CIS-L1/L2 entry. Creating a BitLocker To Go drive needs Windows Pro/Enterprise/Education. Takes effect when a drive is inserted again; no restart. Level 3 only, because small offices often exchange files on plain USB sticks.
controls.requirement: BitLocker: Windows Pro, Enterprise ili Education.

controls.title: Zaštita u stvarnom vremenu
controls.description: Defender stalno provjerava datoteke, preuzimanja, privitke i skripte dok se koriste. Postavka drži zaštitu uključenom, pa je korisnik ne može isključiti.
controls.impact: Korisnici ništa ne primjećuju; prekidač za zaštitu u aplikaciji Sigurnost sustava Windows je zaključan.

benchmarks.recommendation: Zaštita u stvarnom vremenu ne smije biti isključena; Nadzor ponašanja programa uključen; Provjera svih preuzetih datoteka i privitaka uključena; Provjera skripti uključena; Zaštita i ažuriranja uključeni već tijekom prvog postavljanja računala
Sva zaštita u stvarnom vremenu uključena, nadzor u oba smjera i automatsko uklanjanje prijetnji

controls.notes: WindowsDefender.admx: DisableRealtimeMonitoring (Turn off real-time protection; Disabled = 0). RealtimeProtection_DisableBehaviorMonitoring / _DisableIOAVProtection / _DisableSriptScanning / _DisableOnAccessProtection / _DisableScanOnRealtimeEnable (Enabled = 0). RealtimeScanDirection enum (0 = incoming and outgoing). OobeEnableRtpAndSigUpdate = 1 (newer ADMX; path taken from the CIS/MSB lists). DisableRoutinelyTakingAction (Turn off routine remediation; Disabled = 0). All are under Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender[\Real-Time Protection]. CIS-L1 covers the first five values; MSB 25H2/26H2 covers all nine. The values only lock protection ON; Tamper Protection is unaffected. If a third-party antivirus is installed, Defender runs passive and these values have no effect. CIS numbering is v4.0.0 (section 18.10.43). In v5.0.1 the Defender section is 18.10.42 (e.g. 18.10.42.10.3). v5.1.0 moved all Defender Antivirus items to the separate CIS Microsoft Defender Antivirus Benchmark v1.0.0.

controls.title: Provjera USB diskova
controls.description: Kod potpunog skeniranja Defender provjerava i umetnute USB memorije i kartice, a ne samo disk računala.
controls.impact: Potpuno skeniranje traje malo dulje kad je USB umetnut.

benchmarks.recommendation: Skeniranje prijenosnih diskova uključeno
Skeniranje prijenosnih diskova uključeno

controls.notes: WindowsDefender.admx Scan_DisableRemovableDriveScanning: Enabled writes DisableRemovableDriveScanning = 0 under ...\Windows Defender\Scan. ADML: when not configured, removable drives are not scanned during a FULL scan. Real-time protection still scans files when they are opened. CIS v4.0.0 numbering; v5.1.0 moved Defender items to the CIS Microsoft Defender Antivirus Benchmark.

controls.title: Blokiranje neželjenih programa
controls.description: Defender zaustavlja potencijalno neželjene programe: alatne trake, programe s oglasima, rudare kriptovaluta i dodatke koji se instaliraju uz besplatne programe.
controls.impact: Rijetko se neki besplatni program s dodacima neće instalirati dok ga IT ne odobri.

benchmarks.recommendation: Uključeno: blokiraj
Uključeno: blokiraj

controls.notes: Current location: WindowsDefender.admx policy Root_PUAProtection ('Configure detection for potentially unwanted applications') writes Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender!PUAProtection, enum 0 = off, 1 = block, 2 = audit. The historic location Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender\MpEngine!MpEnablePus comes from the Windows 10 1607/1703-era ADMX. It is obsolete and absent from both the current ADMX and the CIS/MSB checks, so it is not written. Microsoft Edge has its own PUA download blocking (SmartScreenPuaEnabled); that belongs to the browser/apps group.

controls.title: Zaštita iz oblaka
controls.description: Defender šalje Microsoftu podatke o sumnjivim datotekama i u nekoliko sekundi dobiva odgovor. Tako prepoznaje i potpuno nove viruse.
controls.impact: Korisnici obično ništa ne primjećuju; uz 'Pojačano' se nova sumnjiva datoteka ponekad otvori nekoliko sekundi kasnije, dok se ne provjeri.

benchmarks.recommendation: Lokalni administrator ne smije mijenjati postavku slanja podataka Microsoftu
Slanje podataka Microsoftu (MAPS) isključeno, zbog privatnosti
Napredno članstvo u MAPS-u, slanje svih uzoraka, visoka razina blokiranja i produžena provjera do 50 sekundi

controls.notes: CONFLICT between standards. CIS L2 wants 'Join Microsoft MAPS' = Disabled for privacy (v4.0.0 18.10.43.5.2; still 'Disabled' at L2 in Fleet's v5.0.1 policy set). MSB 25H2/26H2 wants: Advanced MAPS (SpynetReporting=2); 'Send file samples' = Send all samples (SubmitSamplesConsent=3; the 22H2 baseline still used 1 = Send safe samples); Block at First Sight on (DisableBlockAtFirstSeen=0); cloud protection level High (MpCloudBlockLevel=2); extended cloud check of 50 s (MpBafsExtendedTimeout=50). With MAPS off, Block at First Sight, cloud-delivered protection and the ASR ransomware rule (c1db55ab) stop working. So 'Isključeno' is offered only for CIS L2 parity, and no level uses it. WindowsDefender.admx enums: SpynetReporting 0 Disabled / 1 Basic / 2 Advanced; SubmitSamplesConsent 0 Always prompt / 1 Send safe samples / 2 Never send / 3 Send all samples; MpCloudBlockLevel 0/1/2/4/6; MpBafsExtendedTimeout 0-50. The 'Disabled' state of the SpynetReporting policy deletes the value. The CIS audit accepts a missing value or 0, so writing 0 satisfies it. LocalSettingOverrideSpynetReporting=0 is CIS L1 and is part of every option. Privacy: 'Send all samples' may upload documents (e.g. Office files with macros) for analysis. For very sensitive data an admin may prefer 'Uključeno' (safe samples only).

controls.title: Zaštita od opasnih web stranica
controls.description: Blokira spajanje na poznate lažne (phishing) i zaražene web stranice iz bilo kojeg programa, ne samo iz preglednika.
controls.impact: Kad je opasna stranica blokirana, korisnik vidi obavijest; obične stranice rade bez promjene.

settings.key: Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Windows Defender Exploit Guard\Network Protection
Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Windows Defender Exploit Guard\Network Protection

benchmarks.recommendation: Uključeno: blokiraj
Upozorenja o opasnim stranicama pretvoriti u blokadu
Uključeno: blokiraj, upozorenja se pretvaraju u blokadu

controls.notes: WindowsDefender.admx ExploitGuard_EnableNetworkProtection: ...\Windows Defender Exploit Guard\Network Protection!EnableNetworkProtection, enum 0 off / 1 block / 2 audit. EnableConvertWarnToBlock (Network Inspection System > Convert warn verdict to block) = 1 under ...\Windows Defender\NIS is a newer ADMX policy. Its path and value come from the CIS v4.0.0 (L2) and MSB 25H2 lists and Fleet v5.0.1. It needs Defender Antivirus active with real-time protection, and reputation lookups rely on cloud protection. Windows Server also needs AllowNetworkProtectionOnWinServer (not relevant for Windows 11).

controls.title: Pravila protiv tipičnih napada (ASR)
controls.description: Sprječava trikove kojima se napadači najčešće služe: Office ili PDF koji pokreće programe, skrivene skripte, krađu lozinki iz memorije i nepotpisane programe s USB-a.
controls.impact: Uglavnom ništa; rijetko stari makro ili dodatak za Office prestane raditi pa ga IT mora izuzeti.

benchmarks.recommendation: Pravila za smanjenje površine napada uključena
13 navedenih pravila u načinu 'Blokiraj'
14 pravila 'Blokiraj' (uključujući zaštitu od ransomwarea), pravilo za PsExec/WMI samo bilježi

controls.notes: Registry: ExploitGuard_ASR_Rules = REG_DWORD 1 under Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Windows Defender Exploit Guard\ASR. Each rule is a value named by its GUID under ...\ASR\Rules with REG_SZ data, not DWORD (ADMX <list explicitValue='true'>): '0' off, '1' block, '2' audit, '5' not configured, '6' warn. Options: 'Samo bilježi' = all 15 rules '2'. 'Osnovna zaštita' = Microsoft's three 'standard protection' rules in block and the other 12 in audit, so IT can review events before full block. 'Blokiraj' = 14 rules block + PsExec/WMI audit, which satisfies both CIS L1 (13 rules block) and MSB 25H2/26H2. Rules: 56a863a9-875e-4185-98a7-b882c64b5ce5 = Block abuse of exploited vulnerable signed drivers [MS standard protection, CIS L1 block, MSB block]; 9e6c4e1f-7d60-472f-ba1a-a39ef669e4b2 = Block credential stealing from the Windows local security authority subsystem (lsass.exe) [MS standard protection, CIS L1 block, MSB block]; e6db77e5-3df2-4cf1-b95a-636979351e5b = Block persistence through WMI event subscription [MS standard protection, CIS L1 block, MSB block]; 7674ba52-37eb-4a4f-a9a1-f0f9a1619a2c = Block Adobe Reader from creating child processes [CIS L1 block, MSB block]; d4f940ab-401b-4efc-aadc-ad5f3c50688a = Block all Office applications from creating child processes [CIS L1 block, MSB block]; be9ba2d9-53ea-4cdc-84e5-9b1eeee46550 = Block executable content from email client and webmail [CIS L1 block, MSB block]; 5beb7efe-fd9a-4556-801d-275e5ffc04cc = Block execution of potentially obfuscated scripts [CIS L1 block, MSB block]; d3e037e1-3eb8-44c8-a917-57927947596d = Block JavaScript or VBScript from launching downloaded executable content [CIS L1 block, MSB block]; 3b576869-a4ec-4529-8536-b80a7769e899 = Block Office applications from creating executable content [CIS L1 block, MSB block]; 75668c1f-73b5-4cf0-bb93-3ecf5cb7cc84 = Block Office applications from injecting code into other processes [CIS L1 block, MSB block]; 26190899-1602-49e8-8b27-eb1d0a1ce869 = Block Office communication application from creating child processes [CIS L1 block, MSB block]; b2b3f03d-6a65-4f7b-a9c7-1c7ef74a9ba4 = Block untrusted and unsigned processes that run from USB [CIS L1 block, MSB block]; 92e97fa1-2edf-4476-bdd6-9dd0b4dddc7b = Block Win32 API calls from Office macros [CIS L1 block, MSB block]; c1db55ab-c21a-4637-bb3f-a12568109d35 = Use advanced protection against ransomware [MSB block]; d1e49aac-8f56-4280-b9ba-993a6d77406c = Block process creations originating from PSExec and WMI commands [MSB audit]. Not in CIS or MSB, intentionally left unconfigured: 01443614-cd74-433a-b99e-2ecdc07bfc25 (executables unless prevalence/age/trusted list), c0033c00-d16d-4114-a5a0-dc9b3a7d2ceb (copied or impersonated system tools), 33ddedf1-c6e0-47cb-833e-de6133960387 (rebooting into Safe Mode), a8f5898e-1dc8-49a9-9878-85004b8a61e6 (webshell creation, servers). Caveats: needs Defender Antivirus as the active antivirus. The ransomware rule needs cloud protection. The WMI persistence rule can interfere with the Configuration Manager client, and the PsExec/WMI rule with management tools (hence audit). ASR-only exclusions (ExploitGuard_ASR_ASROnlyExclusions) are not managed here. CIS item numbers are v4.0.0 (v3.0.0: 18.10.42.6.1.1/.2; v5.0.1 table of contents: 18.10.42.6.1.2).

controls.title: SmartScreen za preuzete programe
controls.description: Prije pokretanja programa preuzetog s interneta Windows provjerava je li poznat i siguran. Nepoznati ili opasni programi se zaustavljaju.
controls.impact: Kod nepoznatog programa pojavi se upozorenje; uz 'Blokiraj' korisnik ga ne može zaobići pa takav program instalira IT.

benchmarks.recommendation: Uključeno: upozori i spriječi zaobilaženje
Uključeno: upozori i spriječi zaobilaženje

controls.notes: WindowsExplorer.admx policy EnableSmartScreen (Windows Components > Windows Defender SmartScreen > Explorer > Configure Windows Defender SmartScreen) writes EnableSmartScreen = REG_DWORD 1 under Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System. Its dropdown element ShellSmartScreenLevel = REG_SZ 'Block' (Warn and prevent bypass) or 'Warn'. EnableSmartScreen = 0 would turn SmartScreen off; we never write it. This setting is not in the Defender Antivirus section, so it stays in CIS Windows 11 v5.x. The reference shown is v4.0.0; v5.x numbering was not verified. Microsoft Edge SmartScreen and Enhanced Phishing Protection (WTDS) are separate settings.

controls.title: Temeljitije skeniranje
controls.description: Defender provjerava i e-poštu spremljenu na računalu te mape izuzete iz skeniranja, a pokreće brzo skeniranje ako se tjedan dana ništa nije skeniralo.
controls.impact: Ponekad se pokrene dodatno brzo skeniranje koje kratko uspori računalo.

benchmarks.recommendation: Provjera e-pošte uključena; Brzo skeniranje nakon 7 dana bez skeniranja; Izuzete mape i datoteke provjeravaju se kod brzog skeniranja; Izračun sažetka (hash) datoteka uključen
Izuzete mape i datoteke provjeravaju se kod brzog skeniranja

controls.notes: Values under Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender: Scan\DisableEmailScanning = 0 (Turn on e-mail scanning; mailbox files such as .pst/.mbx on disk). Scan\DaysUntilAggressiveCatchupQuickScan = 7 (CIS wants exactly 'Enabled: 7'). Scan\QuickScanIncludeExclusions = 1 (CIS L1 + MSB). MpEngine\EnableFileHashComputation = 1 (CIS L1). DisableEmailScanning and EnableFileHashComputation were checked in WindowsDefender.admx. The two newer Scan values were checked against the CIS v4.0.0/MSB 25H2 lists and Fleet v5.0.1. 'Scan packed executables' (DisablePackedExeScanning = 0, CIS v4.0.0 18.10.43.13.2) is intentionally left out: Microsoft removed it from the 25H2 baseline as no longer functional, because packed executables are always scanned.

controls.title: Skriveni popis iznimaka
controls.description: Popis mapa i datoteka koje antivirus preskače ne prikazuje se na računalu. Napadač tako ne može lako saznati gdje bi sakrio zlonamjerni program.
controls.impact: Korisnici ništa ne primjećuju; iznimke se ne vide u aplikaciji Sigurnost sustava Windows, ni lokalnim administratorima.

benchmarks.recommendation: Iznimke skrivene od lokalnih korisnika
Iznimke skrivene od lokalnih administratora

controls.notes: HideExclusionsFromLocalAdmins (WindowsDefender.admx, Enabled = 1) is the MSB setting, and it also hides exclusions from standard users. HideExclusionsFromLocalUsers = 1 (newer ADMX) is the CIS L1 item. Both are under Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender. Exclusions set by policy stay readable in the GPO/Registry.pol. Local admins no longer see them in Windows Security or Get-MpPreference, so troubleshoot from the policy itself.

controls.title: Vatrozid uključen na svim mrežama
controls.description: Uključuje Windows vatrozid na mreži u domeni, privatnoj i javnoj mreži. Neželjene dolazne veze se blokiraju, a odlazni promet (internet, e-pošta) ostaje dopušten.
controls.impact: Obično se ništa ne mijenja. U strogom načinu Windows ne pita smije li program primati veze, pa takvi programi na javnim mrežama mogu prestati raditi.

benchmarks.recommendation: Vatrozid uključen na profilima domena, privatno i javno; Dolazne veze: blokiraj (zadano) na sva tri profila
Ne prikazuj obavijest kad je program blokiran; Na javnoj mreži ne primjenjuj lokalna pravila vatrozida ni lokalna pravila sigurnosti veze
Uključen na svim profilima, dolazno blokirano, odlazno dopušteno, bez obavijesti; na javnoj mreži zanemaruje lokalna pravila

controls.notes: Keys are the Windows Firewall with Advanced Security policy keys (PrivateProfile, not the legacy ADMX StandardProfile). They can be written through Registry.pol or Set-GPRegistryValue. 'strogo' adds DisableNotifications=1 on all profiles. On the Public profile it also adds AllowLocalPolicyMerge=0 and AllowLocalIPsecPolicyMerge=0: rules in the local store (e.g. added by app installers or netsh) are then ignored on public networks and only policy-delivered rules apply. When this is applied through LOCAL Group Policy, test apps that need inbound connections on public Wi-Fi. MSB values come from the 24H2 GPO report and the Intune 26H2 MDM baseline: inbound Block, outbound Allow, Disable Inbound Notifications=True, local rules No on Public. If a third-party firewall (AV suite) is registered in Windows Security Center, coordinate before enforcing. CIS v5 may no longer list 'Outbound connections: Allow'; DefaultOutboundAction=0 is still written so outbound traffic stays allowed.

controls.title: Zapisivanje prometa vatrozida
controls.description: Vatrozid zapisuje blokirane i dopuštene veze u datoteku, do 16 MB po vrsti mreže. Zapis pomaže kad treba istražiti napad ili problem s mrežom.
controls.impact: Korisnici ništa ne primjećuju.

benchmarks.recommendation: Na sva tri profila: ime datoteke zapisa postavljeno, veličina 16.384 KB ili više, bilježi odbačene pakete i uspješne veze
Veličina zapisa 16.384 KB, bilježi odbačene pakete i uspješne veze

controls.notes: matchMode atLeast is meant for LogFileSize: a larger log is fine, and CIS asks for 16,384 KB or greater. LogDroppedPackets and LogSuccessfulConnections are already at their maximum value (1). LogFilePath is a string: the state reader must compare it exactly or only check that it is present, never numerically. CIS v5.x only requires that a log name is configured (v3/v4 required these exact paths). MSB sets the size and both logging flags but no custom path. Microsoft recommends at least 20 MB (max 32,767 KB), so a larger size is acceptable. The default folder %SystemRoot%\System32\LogFiles\Firewall already carries the MpsSvc write ACL.

controls.title: Isključi zastarjeli SMB protokol
controls.description: SMB je protokol za dijeljene mape i pisače. Stara inačica SMBv1 ima poznate sigurnosne rupe (npr. WannaCry) i treba je isključiti. Strože opcije traže i noviju inačicu SMB 3.
controls.impact: Vrlo stari NAS uređaji, skeneri i računala sa sustavom Windows XP ili 7 možda se neće moći spojiti na dijeljene mape.

benchmarks.recommendation: SMBv1 klijent isključen ('Configure SMB v1 client driver': Disable driver); SMBv1 poslužitelj isključen
Najniža dopuštena inačica SMB 3.1.1 (poslužitelj i klijent)
SMBv1 isključen; najniža inačica SMB 3.0.0 (od 24H2)

controls.notes: SMB1=0 (LanmanServer\Parameters) and mrxsmb10 Start=4 are the MS Security Guide values 'Configure SMB v1 server: Disabled' and 'Configure SMB v1 client driver: Enabled: Disable driver'. Both appear in the MSB 24H2 GPO report. Clean Windows 11 installs no longer include SMBv1, so on most PCs this only locks the state. The mrxsmb10 key may not exist: writing Start=4 creates a harmless stub key, and the state reader should treat a missing mrxsmb10 service as compliant. Do NOT write the pre-Win8.1 LanmanWorkstation DependOnService value. MinSmb2Dialect ('Mandate the minimum version of SMB', LanmanWorkstation/LanmanServer policy keys) is honoured only on Windows 11 24H2+ and Server 2025. 768 = 0x300 = SMB 3.0.0 (MSB); 785 = 0x311 = SMB 3.1.1 (CIS L1). The server-side minimum also blocks older MFPs/scanners that scan to a folder on this PC over SMB 2.x. MinSmb2Dialect does not disable SMB1 by itself. matchMode is exact because SMB1/Start must match exactly; a PC with 785 is reported as 'smb311'.

controls.title: Obavezno potpisivanje SMB prometa
controls.description: Promet prema dijeljenim mapama digitalno se potpisuje, pa ga napadač u mreži ne može neprimjetno mijenjati ili preusmjeriti. Lozinke se nikad ne šalju nešifrirane.
controls.impact: Kopiranje s NAS-a može biti malo sporije. Vrlo stari NAS uređaji bez potpisivanja i mape bez lozinke prestat će raditi.

benchmarks.recommendation: Klijent uvijek potpisuje SMB promet; Ne šalji nešifriranu lozinku SMB poslužiteljima drugih proizvođača; Poslužitelj uvijek traži potpisani SMB promet
Potpisivanje uvijek obavezno za klijent i poslužitelj; nešifrirana lozinka zabranjena

controls.notes: These are the Security Options 'Microsoft network client/server: Digitally sign communications (always)' and 'Microsoft network client: Send unencrypted password to third-party SMB servers'. They can be written through Registry.pol and also exist in secedit [Registry Values]. Windows 11 24H2+ already requires SMB signing by default for inbound and outbound connections (Pro/Enterprise/Education); this locks the behaviour and applies it to older builds. Signing is incompatible with guest (passwordless) sessions, so expect old NAS devices with guest shares to fail. CIS v5 removed the '(if server agrees)' and '(if client agrees)' items, which only affect SMB1. Their removal shifted the numbering: 2.3.8.2 is now the plaintext-password item and 2.3.9.3 is 'Disconnect clients when logon hours expire'. EnableSecuritySignature is therefore not written.

controls.title: Zabrani gostujući pristup mapama
controls.description: Windows se neće spajati na dijeljene mape koje ne traže korisničko ime i lozinku. Takve veze napadač lako lažira i preko njih podmeće zlonamjerne datoteke.
controls.impact: Dijeljene mape bez lozinke na starim NAS uređajima prestat će raditi dok se na njima ne postave korisnički računi.

benchmarks.recommendation: 'Enable insecure guest logons' isključeno
Nesigurne gostujuće prijave isključene

controls.notes: Added control (not in the draft). This is the policy 'Network\Lanman Workstation\Enable insecure guest logons: Disabled'. It is already the default on Enterprise/Education since 1709 and on Pro since 24H2, so here it mainly locks the state on older Pro builds. It belongs with network.smb-signing, because guest sessions cannot be signed.

controls.title: Isključi LLMNR otkrivanje imena
controls.description: LLMNR je stari način traženja računala po imenu u lokalnoj mreži. Napadači ga koriste za krađu lozinki lažnim odgovorima, a DNS ga u potpunosti zamjenjuje.
controls.impact: Korisnici obično ništa ne primjećuju; računala se i dalje pronalaze preko DNS-a.

benchmarks.recommendation: 'Turn off multicast name resolution' uključeno (LLMNR isključen)
LLMNR isključen

controls.notes: This is the policy 'Network\DNS Client\Turn off multicast name resolution: Enabled'. EnableMulticast=0 disables LLMNR; some forum posts claim the opposite value, which is wrong. If a small office has no local DNS, names then resolve via NetBIOS (until network.netbios is applied) and mDNS.

controls.title: Isključi NetBIOS otkrivanje imena
controls.description: NetBIOS je zastarjeli način pronalaženja računala slanjem upita cijeloj mreži. Isključivanje sprječava napade lažnim odgovorima i krađu lozinki.
controls.impact: Ako u mreži nema DNS poslužitelja, stari uređaji se možda neće pronaći po imenu (npr. \\NAS), nego samo po IP adresi.

benchmarks.recommendation: 'Configure NetBIOS settings': NetBIOS isključen barem na javnim mrežama
NetBT NodeType: P-node (bez emitiranja upita cijeloj mreži)
NodeType P-node i NetBIOS razrješavanje imena isključeno na svim mrežama (od 25H2)

controls.notes: EnableNetbios is the policy 'Network\DNS Client\Configure NetBIOS settings' (22H2+ ADMX). 0 = disable NetBIOS name resolution, 1 = allow, 2 = disable on public networks (the OS default, so 'javne' only locks it), 3 = learning mode. MSB 25H2+ sets 0. CIS L1 requires 'disable on public networks'; 0 is stricter and accepted. NodeType=2 (P-node) is the SecGuide setting 'NetBT NodeType configuration' and is in the MSB 24H2 report as Netbt\Parameters NodeType=2. It stops NetBIOS broadcasts, so without a WINS server NetBIOS name resolution fails; it needs a restart. Neither value unbinds NetBIOS over TCP/IP from the adapters.

controls.title: Isključi mDNS otkrivanje imena
controls.description: mDNS traži uređaje u lokalnoj mreži bez DNS poslužitelja. Isključivanje smanjuje mogućnost lažnih odgovora, ali isključuje i automatsko pronalaženje uređaja.
controls.impact: Automatsko pronalaženje mrežnih pisača, Chromecasta i sličnih uređaja može prestati raditi.

benchmarks.recommendation: 'Configure multicast DNS (mDNS) protocol' isključeno

controls.notes: Added control (not in the draft). This is the policy 'Configure multicast DNS (mDNS) protocol' (Windows 11 24H2+ DnsClient.admx). It is CIS L1 (18.6.4.1 in v4.0.0 and v5.0.1) and not in the MS baseline. It sits at level 3 only for two reasons: Windows uses mDNS for printer and device discovery, and once LLMNR and NetBIOS are off (level 2) mDNS is the last fallback for local names in networks without local DNS. The policy value name EnableMDNS under the DNSClient policy key comes from PolicyPicker and Tenable; please re-check against DnsClient.admx. The non-policy equivalent is Dnscache\Parameters EnableMDNS, which is read at boot.

controls.title: Zabrani anonimno izlistavanje podataka
controls.description: Anonimni korisnici iz mreže ne mogu dobiti popis korisničkih računa i dijeljenih mapa ovog računala. Napadači takve popise koriste za pripremu napada.
controls.impact: Korisnici ništa ne primjećuju.

benchmarks.recommendation: Zabrani anonimno prevođenje SID/ime, anonimno izlistavanje računa i dijeljenih mapa, anonimni pristup cijevima i dijeljenjima; udaljeni SAM samo za administratore
Zabrana anonimnog izlistavanja računa i dijeljenih mapa, ograničen anonimni pristup cijevima i dijeljenjima, udaljeni SAM samo za administratore

controls.notes: Security Options covered: 'Do not allow anonymous enumeration of SAM accounts' (RestrictAnonymousSAM), '... of SAM accounts and shares' (RestrictAnonymous), 'Let Everyone permissions apply to anonymous users: Disabled', 'Restrict anonymous access to Named Pipes and Shares', 'Restrict clients allowed to make remote calls to SAM: Administrators: Remote Access: Allow' (SDDL O:BAG:BAD:(A;;RC;;;BA)) and 'Allow anonymous SID/Name translation: Disabled' (secedit LSAAnonymousNameLookup). Most are already Windows defaults; RestrictAnonymous=1 is the main real change. Only very old (NT4-era) browse or trust scenarios might break. EveryoneIncludesAnonymous and LSAAnonymousNameLookup are CIS-only. The v5.0.1 excerpt cut off the value for 2.3.10.5; 'Disabled' is assumed, as in all earlier versions.

controls.title: Samo sigurna NTLMv2 prijava
controls.description: Za mrežnu prijavu računalo koristi samo noviju inačicu NTLMv2 i odbija stare LM i NTLM prijave koje se lako razbijaju. Slabi LM sažeci lozinki se ne spremaju.
controls.impact: Vrlo stari uređaji, npr. skeneri koji spremaju dokumente u dijeljenu mapu ovog računala, mogu se prestati prijavljivati.

benchmarks.recommendation: LAN Manager razina provjere: šalji samo NTLMv2, odbij LM i NTLM; Najmanja NTLM SSP zaštita (klijent i poslužitelj): NTLMv2 sesija i 128-bitno šifriranje
Samo NTLMv2 (odbij LM i NTLM), bez spremanja LM sažetka, NTLMv2 sesija i 128-bitno šifriranje

controls.notes: LmCompatibilityLevel 5 = 'Send NTLMv2 response only. Refuse LM & NTLM'. In CIS v5.x it is 2.3.11.6; in v3/v4 it was 2.3.11.7. NTLMMinClientSec/NTLMMinServerSec 537395200 (0x20080000) = 'Require NTLMv2 session security, Require 128-bit encryption'. NoLMHash=1 is the OS default. CIS v5.x dropped 'Do not store LAN Manager hash value' (it was 2.3.11.5 in v4.0.0; that slot is now 'Force logoff when logon hours expire'), but MSB 24H2 and DISA STIG WN11-SO-000195 still require it. The NTLM SSP items were not visible in the MSB 24H2 report excerpt I could read. They have been part of every Windows baseline, but re-check them in the SCT 26H2 package. Kerberos is unaffected. The 'refuse' part only matters when this PC acts as the server (shares on the PC, scan-to-folder).

controls.title: Zaštićen pristup domenskim skriptama
controls.description: Kad je računalo u domeni, provjerava da skripte prijave i pravila grupe stvarno dolaze s domenskog kontrolera. Tako lažni poslužitelj ne može podmetnuti zlonamjerne postavke.
controls.impact: Korisnici ništa ne primjećuju.

benchmarks.recommendation: Hardened UNC Paths za NETLOGON i SYSVOL: međusobna provjera, integritet i privatnost (šifriranje)
Hardened UNC Paths za NETLOGON i SYSVOL: međusobna provjera i integritet

controls.notes: Added control (not in the draft). This is the policy 'Network\Network Provider\Hardened UNC Paths' (MS15-011). Value names are the literal UNC patterns \\*\NETLOGON and \\*\SYSVOL. It only has an effect on domain-joined PCs and is harmless in a workgroup. RequirePrivacy=1 needs SMB 3 encryption on the domain controllers (Server 2012+). CIS v5 requires privacy; MSB and DISA STIG require only mutual authentication and integrity. Windows 10+ already applies mutual auth and integrity to these paths by default, so 'potpis' mainly locks it.
controls.requirement: Djeluje samo na računalima u domeni.

controls.title: Zaštita od preusmjeravanja prometa
controls.description: Isključuje stare mrežne značajke (izvorno usmjeravanje i ICMP preusmjeravanje) kojima napadač može preusmjeriti promet. Računalo ignorira i lažne zahtjeve za oslobađanje NetBIOS imena.
controls.impact: Korisnici ništa ne primjećuju.

benchmarks.recommendation: Izvorno usmjeravanje potpuno isključeno (IPv4 i IPv6); ICMP preusmjeravanja isključena; Ignoriraj zahtjeve za oslobađanje NetBIOS imena osim od WINS poslužitelja
Izvorno usmjeravanje isključeno (IPv4/IPv6), ICMP preusmjeravanja isključena, NoNameReleaseOnDemand uključen

controls.notes: Added control (not in the draft). These are the MSS (Legacy) settings from MSS-legacy.admx in the Security Compliance Toolkit. DisableIPSourceRouting 2 = highest protection (source routing completely disabled). The values are read at TCP/IP and NetBT start, so a restart is needed. The CIS numbers (18.5.2/3/5/7) are the same in v3.0.0, v4.0.0 and v5.0.1. MSB presence was confirmed via the Intune 24H2 baseline and the MSCT Windows 11 audit; I could not see it in the GPO report excerpt.

controls.title: Udaljena radna površina (RDP)
controls.description: Određuje smije li se netko spojiti na ovo računalo preko Udaljene radne površine i uz koju zaštitu. Sigurne opcije traže provjeru korisnika prije spajanja i šifriranu vezu.
controls.impact: Ovisno o izboru: lozinka se upisuje pri svakom spajanju, lokalni diskovi se ne prenose u sesiju ili je spajanje na ovo računalo potpuno onemogućeno.

benchmarks.recommendation: Ne dopuštaj spremanje lozinki u klijentu Udaljene radne površine; Ne dopuštaj preusmjeravanje lokalnih diskova u sesiju; Uvijek traži lozinku pri spajanju
Obavezna sigurna RPC komunikacija; Sigurnosni sloj: SSL (TLS); Provjera korisnika prije spajanja (NLA); Razina šifriranja veze: visoka
Spajanje preko Udaljene radne površine onemogućeno
Bez spremanja lozinki, bez preusmjeravanja diskova, uvijek traži lozinku, sigurni RPC, visoka razina šifriranja

controls.notes: No option turns RDP on. 'osnovno' and 'sigurno' leave fDenyTSConnections untouched and only harden RDP if someone enables it. 'zabranjeno' sets fDenyTSConnections=1 (CIS L2) and keeps all hardening values, so the CIS L1 items still read as compliant at level 3. DisablePasswordSaving is a client-side (mstsc) setting. NLA (UserAuthentication) and SecurityLayer are CIS-only; MSB does not set them (they are effectively OS defaults). Windows 11 Home has no RDP host, and the policies are harmless there. 'zabranjeno' affects remote-management tools that rely on inbound RDP, but not TeamViewer, AnyDesk or Quick Assist. Not included: the CIS L2 items for idle-session limit (updated in v5.1.0), COM/LPT/PnP/location/WebAuthn redirection, and single session. Also outside this control: the MS 26H2 baseline enables Administrator protection, which per secondary reports (KB5124010) can block non-admin RDP sign-ins.

controls.title: Isključi Windows Udaljenu pomoć
controls.description: Isključuje staru Windows značajku Udaljena pomoć (Remote Assistance), i kad korisnik sam traži pomoć i kad je netko nudi. Prevaranti je koriste za lažnu 'tehničku podršku'.
controls.impact: Korisnici ništa ne primjećuju; Brza pomoć (Quick Assist), TeamViewer i AnyDesk i dalje rade.

benchmarks.recommendation: 'Configure Offer Remote Assistance' isključeno; 'Configure Solicited Remote Assistance' isključeno
Zatražena udaljena pomoć isključena

controls.notes: These are the policies 'System\Remote Assistance\Configure Offer Remote Assistance: Disabled' (fAllowUnsolicited=0) and 'Configure Solicited Remote Assistance: Disabled' (fAllowToGetHelp=0). MSB configures only Solicited; Offer is CIS-only and already disabled by default. CIS numbering moved from 18.9.35.x (v3/v4) to 18.9.37.x (v5.0.1). Quick Assist is a separate app and is not controlled by these policies.

controls.title: Edge: zaštita od phishinga
controls.description: Microsoft Edge blokira poznate phishing i zlonamjerne stranice i preuzimanja, bez mogućnosti zaobilaženja.
controls.impact: Korisnik ne može otvoriti stranicu ili datoteku koju SmartScreen označi opasnom.

benchmarks.recommendation: Edge baseline: SmartScreen uključen, bez zaobilaženja

controls.title: Office: blokiraj makronaredbe s interneta
controls.description: Makronaredbe u Word, Excel i PowerPoint datotekama preuzetim s interneta ili iz e-pošte ne mogu se pokrenuti.
controls.impact: Datoteke s makronaredbama iz interneta otvaraju se bez makronaredbi.

benchmarks.recommendation: Microsoft 365 Apps baseline: blokirano

controls.title: Office: makronaredbe općenito
controls.description: Određuje smiju li se makronaredbe pokretati u Office datotekama.
controls.impact: Ovisno o izboru korisnik vidi upozorenje ili se pokreću samo potpisane makronaredbe.

benchmarks.recommendation: Microsoft 365 Apps baseline: samo potpisane

controls.title: Isključena Microsoft Trgovina
controls.description: Korisnici ne mogu instalirati aplikacije iz Microsoft Trgovine. Korisno za javna računala i kioske.
controls.impact: Trgovina se ne otvara (samo Windows Enterprise i Education).
controls.requirement: Windows Enterprise ili Education; na Pro izdanju nema učinka.

controls.title: Isključen Windows Script Host
controls.description: Zabranjuje pokretanje .vbs i .js skripti koje napadači često šalju e-poštom.
controls.impact: Stare prijavne skripte u .vbs obliku prestaju raditi.

controls.title: Dijagnostički podaci Microsoftu
controls.description: Određuje koliko podataka o radu računala Windows šalje Microsoftu. Manje podataka znači bolju privatnost.
controls.impact: Korisnici ništa ne primjećuju.

benchmarks.recommendation: Isključeno ili samo obavezni dijagnostički podaci

controls.notes: GP 'Allow Diagnostic Data'. Windows 11 values: 0 = diagnostic data off, 1 = Required, 3 = Optional (2/Enhanced is retired on Windows 11). Only Enterprise, Education, IoT Enterprise and Server honour 0; Pro/Home silently treat it as 1, so show an edition hint when 'Isključeno' is picked on Pro. With 0, Windows Update for Business reports, Autopatch, Intune Endpoint analytics and similar Microsoft reporting lose data; Windows Update itself keeps working. CIS L1 accepts 0 or 1 (audit operator <= 1). Not in MSB.
controls.requirement: Opcija 'Isključeno' djeluje samo na Enterprise i Education; Pro tada šalje samo obavezne podatke.

controls.title: Bez anketa i dodatnih zapisa
controls.description: Windows više ne traži od korisnika ocjene i povratne informacije. Microsoftu šalje i manje dodatnih zapisa i ispisa memorije nakon rušenja.
controls.impact: Korisnici više ne vide skočne ankete za povratne informacije.

benchmarks.recommendation: Ne prikazivati obavijesti za povratne informacije; Ograničiti prikupljanje dijagnostičkih zapisa; Ograničiti prikupljanje ispisa memorije (dump); Isključiti preuzimanje postavki s usluge OneSettings; Bilježiti upite prema usluzi OneSettings

controls.notes: Five CIS L1 'Data Collection and Preview Builds' items merged into one switch. All values are DWORD 1 under Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DataCollection. DisableOneSettingsDownloads stops Windows downloading diagnostic configuration from Microsoft's OneSettings service. CIS rates the impact as minimal, but if a Microsoft diagnostics or reporting feature misbehaves, check this value first. Not in MSB. Works independently of the AllowTelemetry level chosen in privacy.telemetry.

controls.title: Bez praćenja za oglase
controls.description: Isključuje oglasni ID i prilagođene preporuke na temelju dijagnostičkih podataka. Aplikacije tada ne mogu pratiti korisnika radi oglasa.
controls.impact: Korisnici ništa ne primjećuju; oglasi u aplikacijama su manje osobni.

benchmarks.recommendation: Oglasni ID isključen; Ne koristiti dijagnostičke podatke za prilagođena iskustva

controls.notes: Machine GP 'Turn off the advertising ID' (User Profiles) plus User GP 'Do not use diagnostic data for tailored experiences' (Cloud Content). Both are CIS Level 2 only, but users see no difference, so they are on from level 1. Not in MSB. The User value goes into the user part of Registry.pol / the GPO user configuration and applies to every user of the PC.

controls.title: Bez reklama i preporuka
controls.description: Windows ne instalira sam preporučene aplikacije i igre. Ne prikazuje ni reklamne obavijesti ni prijedloge aplikacija drugih tvrtki.
controls.impact: U izborniku Start i postavkama više nema preporučenih aplikacija i reklamnih poruka.

benchmarks.recommendation: Microsoftova potrošačka iskustva isključena; Isključen sadržaj o stanju potrošačkog računa iz oblaka; Bez prijedloga sadržaja drugih tvrtki u Windows Spotlightu
Isključen sadržaj optimiziran iz oblaka
Microsoftova potrošačka iskustva isključena; Bez prijedloga sadržaja drugih tvrtki u Windows Spotlightu

controls.notes: Cloud Content policies. Only Enterprise/Education honour DisableWindowsConsumerFeatures ('Turn off Microsoft consumer experiences'); Pro has ignored it since 1607. DisableThirdPartySuggestions is a User policy and works on Pro. In this area MSB 25H2 and 26H2 contain only the consumer-experiences and third-party-suggestions settings (Intune JSON: Experience/AllowWindowsConsumerFeatures=0, AllowThirdPartySuggestionsInWindowsSpotlight=0). The Spotlight lock-screen/desktop items are in privacy.spotlight.
controls.requirement: Puni učinak na Windows 11 Enterprise i Education; Pro poštuje samo prijedloge trećih strana.

controls.title: Windows Spotlight slike i savjeti
controls.description: Isključuje Spotlight, tj. dnevne slike s interneta, savjete i promotivni sadržaj na zaključanom zaslonu i radnoj površini.
controls.impact: Zaključani zaslon i pozadina prikazuju običnu sliku umjesto dnevne slike s interneta.

benchmarks.recommendation: Spotlight na zaključanom zaslonu isključen (Disabled); Spotlight zbirka na radnoj površini isključena
Sve Spotlight značajke isključene

controls.notes: User-scope Cloud Content policies. 'Configure Windows spotlight on lock screen' = Disabled writes ConfigureWindowsSpotlight=2 (1 would force Spotlight on). Microsoft documents the Spotlight background policies for Enterprise/Education; Pro may ignore them. Level 1 leaves Spotlight alone because it only changes the look and has no security effect. Not in MSB (MSB only sets DisableThirdPartySuggestions; see privacy.consumer-experiences).
controls.requirement: Puni učinak na Windows 11 Enterprise i Education.

controls.title: Privatnost zaključanog zaslona
controls.description: Dok je računalo zaključano, nije moguće koristiti kameru, glasovne naredbe ni prezentaciju slika. Strogi način skriva i obavijesti, da se ne vidi njihov sadržaj.
controls.impact: Kamera i glasovni pomoćnik ne rade na zaključanom zaslonu; obavijesti se vide tek nakon otključavanja.

benchmarks.recommendation: Zabranjena kamera na zaključanom zaslonu; Zabranjena prezentacija slika na zaključanom zaslonu; Aplikacije se ne smiju aktivirati glasom dok je sustav zaključan; Cortana nije dostupna na zaključanom zaslonu
Bez skočnih obavijesti na zaključanom zaslonu
Zabranjena kamera na zaključanom zaslonu; Zabranjena prezentacija slika na zaključanom zaslonu; Aplikacije se ne smiju aktivirati glasom dok je sustav zaključan
Bez skočnih obavijesti na zaključanom zaslonu

controls.notes: LetAppsActivateWithVoiceAboveLock=2 means 'Force Deny' (App Privacy). NoToastApplicationNotificationOnLockScreen is a User policy (Start Menu and Taskbar > Notifications). The related machine policy 'Turn off app notifications on the lock screen' (System\Logon, DisableLockScreenAppNotifications=1, CIS L1 18.9.28.5) is left out so it does not overlap with a logon/lock category owned by another group. Add it here if no other group covers it. AllowCortanaAboveLock sits here rather than in privacy.search because it is about what the lock screen exposes.

controls.title: Isključi lokaciju
controls.description: Windows i aplikacije ne mogu doznati gdje se računalo nalazi. Lokacija se ne šalje ni Microsoftu ni aplikacijama.
controls.impact: Karte, vremenska prognoza, automatska vremenska zona i 'Pronađi moj uređaj' neće raditi.

benchmarks.recommendation: Lokacija isključena

controls.notes: GP 'Location and Sensors > Turn off location'. CIS Level 2 only and not in MSB, so it is on only at level 3. CIS L2 also sets the Geolocation Service (lfsvc) to Disabled (v4.0.0 item 5.6). That is a service start type (secedit [Service General Setting] / System Services), not a Registry.pol value, so it is not written here. Laptops that travel between time zones lose automatic time-zone detection.

controls.title: Pretraživanje bez Cortane
controls.description: Isključuje Cortanu i zabranjuje pretraživanju da koristi lokaciju računala. Strogi način isključuje i rezultate iz oblaka i istaknute teme u pretraživanju.
controls.impact: Pretraživanje datoteka i aplikacija na računalu radi kao i prije.

benchmarks.recommendation: Cortana isključena; Pretraživanje i Cortana ne smiju koristiti lokaciju
Pretraživanje u oblaku isključeno; Istaknuto u pretraživanju (search highlights) isključeno

controls.notes: Windows Search policies under Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Search. Current Windows 11 builds no longer ship the Cortana app; CIS still audits AllowCortana and setting it does no harm. 'Samo lokalno' (AllowCloudSearch=0) removes OneDrive/SharePoint/Outlook work-account results from Windows Search, so say this in the UI for Microsoft 365 offices. Search policy changes may need a sign-out before they show. In this area MSB only sets AllowIndexingEncryptedStoresOrItems=0, which is a security setting rather than privacy and is not part of this group.

controls.title: Povijest aktivnosti
controls.description: Windows ne šalje Microsoftu popis aplikacija, datoteka i stranica koje korisnik otvara. Strogi način potpuno isključuje vođenje te povijesti.
controls.impact: Korisnici uglavnom ništa ne primjećuju; nastavak rada na drugom uređaju neće raditi.

benchmarks.recommendation: Zabranjeno slanje korisničkih aktivnosti

controls.notes: OS Policies: 'Enables Activity Feed' (EnableActivityFeed), 'Allow publishing of User Activities' (PublishUserActivities), 'Allow upload of User Activities' (UploadUserActivities); 0 = Disabled. CIS audits only UploadUserActivities (Level 2). Windows 11 no longer has Timeline, so the real-world impact is small. Not in MSB.

controls.title: Recall snimke zaslona
controls.description: Recall na novim Copilot+ računalima stalno snima zaslon da bi se sadržaj kasnije mogao pretraživati. Ova postavka sprječava spremanje snimki ili potpuno uklanja Recall.
controls.impact: Recall se ne može koristiti; na računalima bez Recalla nema nikakve promjene.
controls.notes: Windows AI policies (WindowsCopilot.admx), key Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsAI. 'Turn off saving snapshots for use with Recall' (DisableAIDataAnalysis=1) exists under both Computer and User configuration, so both scopes are written. Turning it on deletes snapshots that are already saved. 'Allow Recall to be enabled' (AllowRecallEnablement=0, machine only) needs Windows 11 24H2 with KB5055627 (build 26100.3915) or later. It removes the Recall optional component and deletes snapshots. It needs a restart, and bringing Recall back later means restoring the component, so the UI should warn. Only Copilot+ PCs have Recall. On managed (domain/MDM) devices it is off by default, but on small-office workgroup PCs the user may have opted in during setup, so level 1 already blocks snapshots. Benchmarks: not in CIS Windows 11 Enterprise v4.0.0 (absent from the v4 list) and not in MSB 25H2/26H2. CIS Microsoft Windows 11 Stand-alone Benchmark v5.0.0 has 18.10.73.1 (L1) 'Allow Recall to be enabled' = Disabled (per Tenable). CIS Enterprise v5.x very likely has a matching L1 item, which option 'removed' would satisfy. Add a CIS-L1 entry once its v5.x number is confirmed.
controls.requirement: Copilot+ računala s Windows 11 24H2 ili novijim; na ostalima nema učinka.

controls.title: Bez prepoznavanja govora u oblaku
controls.description: Isključuje Microsoftovo mrežno prepoznavanje govora. Glasovni zapisi korisnika ne šalju se u oblak.
controls.impact: Glasovno diktiranje i glasovne naredbe koje trebaju internet neće raditi.

benchmarks.recommendation: Korisnici ne smiju uključiti mrežno prepoznavanje govora

controls.notes: GP 'Control Panel > Regional and Language Options > Allow users to enable online speech recognition services' = Disabled (AllowInputPersonalization=0). Features that run on the device, such as Voice access, keep working. Not in MSB. Left out of level 1 because people who use voice typing would notice.

controls.title: Kontrola korisničkog računa (UAC)
controls.description: UAC traži potvrdu prije nego što program dobije administratorske ovlasti. Tako zlonamjerni program ne može neprimjetno mijenjati sustav.
controls.impact: Uz Preporučeno i Strogo standardni korisnici ne mogu sami instalirati programe, a administratori potvrđuju svaku promjenu sustava.

benchmarks.recommendation: UAC uključen; administratori potvrđuju na sigurnoj radnoj površini (pristanak ili lozinka); zahtjevi standardnih korisnika automatski se odbijaju; ugrađeni Administrator također traži potvrdu
UAC uključen; administratori: pristanak na sigurnoj radnoj površini; standardni korisnici: automatsko odbijanje; ugrađeni Administrator traži potvrdu

controls.notes: All values are Security Options under HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System; writing them through Registry.pol works but tattoos (they stay after the GPO is removed). ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin: 0 elevate without prompt, 1 credentials on secure desktop, 2 consent on secure desktop, 3 credentials, 4 consent, 5 consent for non-Windows binaries (default). ConsentPromptBehaviorUser: 0 auto-deny, 1 credentials on secure desktop, 3 credentials (default). 'standard' = Windows defaults with UAC forced on (repairs a disabled UAC). A restart is only needed when EnableLUA or FilterAdministratorToken actually changes; prompt behaviour applies immediately. With auto-deny, standard users get 'access denied' instead of a password prompt; IT must sign in with an admin account to install software. 'strict' (admin value 1) satisfies CIS ('consent on the secure desktop or higher') and is stricter than MSB's literal 2 - counted as satisfying MSB, but literal-diff tools will flag it. PromptOnSecureDesktop is a CIS item only (MSB leaves the default). CIS v5.0.1 section 2.3.17 numbering is unchanged from v4.0.0 (2.3.17.1-2.3.17.4, 2.3.17.6, 2.3.17.7 confirmed for v5.0.1), which also indicates CIS has not added the Administrator protection settings.

controls.title: Zaštita administratora
controls.description: Novija zaštita u Windowsima 11: administrator radi s običnim ovlastima, a za svaku administratorsku radnju dobiva privremeno, odvojeno ovlaštenje uz potvrdu lozinkom ili Windows Hellom.
controls.impact: Administratori svaku instalaciju ili promjenu sustava potvrđuju lozinkom, PIN-om ili licem; neki stariji alati mogu prestati raditi.

benchmarks.recommendation: Uključena zaštita administratora; potvrda lozinkom na sigurnoj radnoj površini

controls.notes: Windows 11 24H2+ client only (not Server, Windows 365, AVD). Microsoft updated the 26H2 baseline (v2 package) for Administrator protection GA with 'Configure type of Admin Approval Mode' = Admin Approval Mode with Administrator protection (TypeOfAdminApprovalMode=2) and the Administrator-protection prompt = 'Prompt for credentials on the secure desktop'; MC1506291: for baseline users it becomes enabled by default with the October 2026 security update (24H2/25H2/26H2). ConsentPromptBehaviorEnhancedAdmin=1 is used for 'credentials' (AuditTAP's MSB 25H2 check and the 24H2 baseline GPO report both show 1); HardeningKitty's MSB list uses 2, which upstream issue #217 reports as wrong - verify on a test device. Not in CIS v5.0.1. Known issues: Group Policy refresh failures with the baseline on Aug/Sept 2026 previews (reported fixed by KB5127648), conflicts with Endpoint Privilege Management tools, no auto-elevation for Windows binaries, Project Zero bypasses (reported fixed). 'legacy' (1) is Microsoft's documented rollback; it is not tied to any level. Restart required.
controls.requirement: Windows 11 24H2 ili noviji, samo klijentska računala.

controls.title: UAC za mrežne prijave
controls.description: Lokalni administratorski račun koji se prijavljuje preko mreže ne dobiva automatski pune ovlasti. Napadaču je tako teže s jednog zaraženog računala preuzeti ostala.
controls.impact: Korisnici ništa ne primjećuju; neki alati za udaljeno upravljanje koji koriste lokalni administratorski račun mogu trebati domenski račun.

benchmarks.recommendation: Uključeno (UAC ograničenja za lokalne račune pri mrežnoj prijavi)
Uključeno

controls.notes: MS Security Guide (SecGuide.admx) 'Apply UAC restrictions to local accounts on network logons': Enabled = LocalAccountTokenFilterPolicy 0, which is also the Windows default. Breaks remote administration with LOCAL admin accounts (PsExec, admin shares like C$, some RMM/backup agents); domain accounts are not affected.

controls.title: Instalacije bez skrivenih ovlasti
controls.description: Windows Installer (.msi) ne smije svaku instalaciju automatski pokretati s administratorskim ovlastima, a korisnici ne mogu mijenjati sigurnosne opcije instalacije. Inače bi svatko preko .msi paketa mogao preuzeti računalo.
controls.impact: Korisnici ništa ne primjećuju.

benchmarks.recommendation: Isključeno 'Uvijek instaliraj s povišenim ovlastima' (računalo i korisnik) i 'Dopusti korisniku kontrolu nad instalacijama'
Isključeno 'Uvijek instaliraj s povišenim ovlastima' i 'Dopusti korisniku kontrolu nad instalacijama' (računalo)

controls.notes: AlwaysInstallElevated only takes effect when it is 1 in BOTH HKLM and HKCU; forcing 0 in both blocks this classic privilege escalation. In CIS v4.0.0 these are 18.10.81.1 (EnableUserControl), 18.10.81.2 (computer) and 19.7.44.1 (user); the v5.x numbers were not verified (section 18.10 was renumbered), so no reference is given. MSB does not configure the user-scope value. Defaults are already 'not elevated'.

controls.title: Zaštita lozinki u memoriji (LSA)
controls.description: Windows proces koji čuva prijave i lozinke (LSASS) radi kao zaštićeni proces. Alati za krađu lozinki tako ne mogu čitati njegovu memoriju.
controls.impact: Korisnici ništa ne primjećuju; vrlo stari dodaci za prijavu ili sigurnosni programi mogu se prestati učitavati.

benchmarks.recommendation: Uključeno s UEFI zaključavanjem
Uključeno s UEFI zaključavanjem

controls.notes: RunAsPPL: 0 off, 1 on with UEFI lock, 2 on without UEFI lock (Win11 22H2+). Written to BOTH the classic location System\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa (honoured by every build; 23H2 and older templates wrote here) and the 24H2+ ADMX location Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System (what the MSB 25H2 GPO and CIS v5 audit check). With the UEFI lock the state lives in a UEFI variable: deleting the registry values does NOT turn it off; Microsoft's LSA Protected Process Opt-out tool (LSAPPLConfig.efi) at the console is needed. Level 2 deliberately uses 2 (reversible) and therefore does not meet CIS/MSB literally; level 3 matches both. After reboot, System log event 12 (Wininit) confirms protected mode; blocked plug-ins are logged in Microsoft-Windows-CodeIntegrity/Operational. CIS number was 18.9.26.2 in v4.0.0, 18.9.27.2 in v5.0.1.

controls.title: Isključen WDigest
controls.description: Sprječava da Windows za staru WDigest prijavu drži lozinke u memoriji u čitljivom obliku. Napadač tako ne može jednostavno pročitati lozinke prijavljenih korisnika.
controls.impact: Korisnici ništa ne primjećuju.

benchmarks.recommendation: WDigest prijava isključena

controls.notes: Removed from MSB in the 25H2 baseline (deprecated; WDigest credential caching disabled by default since Windows 8.1) and absent from 26H2; still CIS v5.0.1 L1 (18.4.7) and DISA STIG. Explicit 0 guards against attackers/tools setting 1. Applies to new logons (no restart; credentials already cached stay until sign-out). Stale values from older baselines are harmless.

controls.title: Zaštita od zlouporabe grešaka (SEHOP)

controls.impact: Korisnici ništa ne primjećuju.

benchmarks.recommendation: SEHOP uključen
SEHOP uključen

controls.notes: MS Security Guide setting: DisableExceptionChainValidation 0 = SEHOP enabled (kernel reads it at boot). Added beyond the draft list because it is in both standards with no user impact; very old 32-bit apps can be exempted per-app via Exploit protection.
